- TSMC's gross margin for Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026) was 67.7%, reported on a consolidated TIFRS basis. [1][2][3]

- For Q3 FY2026 (quarter ending September 30, 2026), TSMC guides gross profit margin to be between 65% and 67%, based on the exchange rate assumption of 1 US dollar to 32 NT dollars — this is guidance, not an actual result. [1][3][4]
